title: Act Wisely: Cultivating Meta-Cognitive Tool Use in Agentic Multimodal Models
summary: The advent of agentic multimodal models has empowered systems to actively interact with external environments. This decoupled architecture naturally induces a cognitive curriculum-compelling the agent to first master task resolution before refining its self-reliance. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our resulting model, Metis, reduces tool invocations by orders of magnitude while simultaneously elevating reasoning accuracy.
